purpose: Cross-agent presentation contract for the original Championship bottom toolbar. Codex may bind presentation to anything marked ROM_VERIFIED. Everything marked UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_TRACE must stay a neutral placeholder.

sourceEvidence.romTree: local research-only tree; no ROM content is reproduced here
sourceEvidence.method: NDS FNT/FAT parse; ARM9 overlay table at 0xFDA00; per-overlay resource-string scan; targeted ARM9 disassembly

sceneOwner.note: Attached by the ARM9 main binary, not by any overlay.

labelAnchors.note: Runtime-populated text slots. The literal string 'loc_button' appears zero times in ARM9, so slots are addressed positionally, not by name.

slotStorage.derivedFrom: teardown loop ending at ARM9 0x020607D0: ADD R4,R10,#0x64 / CMP R11,#8 / ADD R4,R4,#0x1C0

slotFrameGeometry.note: Frame cells 10 and 11 are the two stagger frames, not per-tool icons. Slot 7 alone uses cell 12; that is structural evidence only and does not name the slot.

revisionNote: RAISING_TOOLBAR_BINDING_CLOSURE delta. Two items closed: slot-to-node ordering and the submenu storage structure. Command and icon-cell bindings remain UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_TRACE.

slotToNodeMapping.table: 0x0209F7C4, eight u32 entries, indexed by slot: LDR R1,[R0,R5,LSL#2] at ARM9 0x02060BF0
slotToNodeMapping.resolvesTo: toolbar.nxr node_index; node 16 is button0 and node 9 is button7
slotToNodeMapping.meaning: Slot order matches button order left to right: slot 0 is the leftmost button at x=38, slot 7 the rightmost at x=220. The descending table is an index inversion, not a reordering of the row.

entryPointerTable.note: Begins exactly where the slot array ends: 0x64 + 8*0x1C0 = 0xE64.

countArray.layout: 8 x 4 bytes, one count per slot

submenuStorage.meaning: Every slot can carry a submenu of up to eight entries; the submenu is not a property of one special slot.
submenuStorage.populationSite: UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_TRACE - ARM9 only ever clears these to zero (0x02060770, 0x02060C70/0x02060C84). No immediate-offset store sets a non-zero count anywhere in ARM9 or OVL18.

slotStructFields.subObject: +0xD4 receives the icon-set handle read from toolbar+0x30 (ARM9 0x02060C24)
slotStructFields.note: Field semantics are not recovered. Do not infer meaning from offset.
